result.title: Enhancing Multi-Step Chemical Mechanism Prediction with Graph-Guided Preference Data
result.summary: Predicting multi-step chemical reaction mechanisms requires identifying plausible intermediates and correctly ordering the elementary reaction steps. Existing computational methods focus on single-step elementary reaction prediction, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen reaction spaces. We introduce a graph-guided framework for multi-step chemical mechanism prediction that leverages a chemical mechanism knowledge graph (ChemMechKG) to guide large language models (LLMs). To improve pathway prediction, we develop a graph-aligned reaction mechanism predictor (GRMP) that uses graph neural networks to generate synthetic candidate pathways for pathway optimization. During inference, we design a relation retrieval (RR) module to extract relevant graph evidence from the KG for pathway refinement. Experiments show that GRMP achieves the highest pathway accuracy among all compared methods on ChemMechQA and oMe-Gold, reaching 48.1% and 57.9%, respectively. On a fixed sample of 110 out-of-distribution reactions from ChemMechQA-Hard, GRMP achieves 36.4% top-1 pathway accuracy. LLM-as-Judge and human assessment further demonstrate its ability to generalize to unseen reactions.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向多步化学反应机理预测，构建化学机理知识图谱来引导 LLM，并用图神经网络生成候选路径做偏好优化，推理阶段再通过关系检索模块从图谱中抽取相关证据对路径进行修正。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「检索外部证据—筛选相关关系—迭代修正候选假设」的推理期流程，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与假设精化问题相通，可供核查；但领域为化学文本与图，非多模态，迁移性需人工判断。
